        int strLen = str.length() - 1;
        StringBuilder finalStr = new StringBuilder();
        StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();
        int atIdx = -1;

        // Find the index of "at"
        for (int i = 1; i <= strLen; i++) {
            if (str.charAt(i) == 'a' && str.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                atIdx = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        // Append first character
        finalStr.append(str.charAt(0));

        // Process the first part
        for (int i = 1; i < atIdx; i++) {
            if (i + 2 <= strLen && str.charAt(i) == 'd' && str.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && str.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                finalStr.append(buffer);
                buffer.setLength(0);
                finalStr.append('.');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                buffer.append(str.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        finalStr.append(buffer);
        finalStr.append('@');

        // Reset buffer for second part
        buffer.setLength(0);

        // Process the second part
        for (int i = atIdx + 2; i <= strLen; i++) {
            if (i + 2 <= strLen && str.charAt(i) == 'd' && str.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && str.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                finalStr.append(buffer);
                buffer.setLength(0);
                finalStr.append('.');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                buffer.append(str.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        finalStr.append(buffer);

        System.out.print(finalStr.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
